create_Projector_causal_conv1d: create a causal Projector module with conv1d to project input channels to a target code dimension
create_Projector_noncausal_conv1d_bn: create a noncausal Projector module with conv1d_bn that adds BatchNorm1d after the convolution layer
run_Projector_forward: run the forward pass of a Projector module on a tensor to project features to code dimension
run_Projector_encode: run the encode method of a Projector module to perform inference-mode encoding with mode validation
review_Projector_init: review the Projector constructor to understand supported modes and model types for audio feature projection
